mistakes.name: Leaning back at contact
mistakes.plain_english: Your upper body is leaning behind your hips when you shoot. The ball goes over the bar or high and wide.
mistakes.root_cause: Plant foot is positioned behind the ball, pulling the body backward.
mistakes.correction: Plant foot beside the ball, not behind it. Drive your chest over the ball at the moment of contact.

mistakes.name: Striking with the toe
mistakes.plain_english: Toe-poking gives you almost no control over direction. The ball can go anywhere.
mistakes.root_cause: Rushing the shot or insufficient approach angle.
mistakes.correction: Strike with the laces or inside of the foot. Take one extra touch to set yourself if needed.

mistakes.name: No follow-through
mistakes.plain_english: You stop your kicking leg at contact. The ball has no power and the direction is unpredictable.
mistakes.root_cause: Tensing up before contact — trying to 'place' the ball rather than strike it.
mistakes.correction: Drive through the ball. Your kicking foot should finish pointing at the target after contact.

mistakes.name: Using wrong foot surface
mistakes.plain_english: Using the wrong part of your foot for the situation reduces both power and placement.
mistakes.root_cause: Lack of deliberate practice with different contact surfaces.
mistakes.correction: Inside foot for placement. Laces for power. Outside of foot for curl. Practise each separately.

mistakes.name: Looking up before contact
mistakes.plain_english: Your head comes up before your foot makes contact with the ball, causing you to miss the strike.
mistakes.root_cause: Anxiety about the goalkeeper or target position.
mistakes.correction: Keep your eyes on the ball until after your foot makes contact. Trust your pre-selected target.
